title.narrative: Integrated people-centered eye-care services in Nimule, Magwi County

description.narrative: Contribute to prevention of avoidable blindness and visual impairment in in Eastern Equatoria State Increased access to quality static and inclusive eye care services and rehabilitation.

Cordaid has experience managing eye health at Torit Hospital and communities. The ophthalmologist in the previous project will lead the technical aspect of the implementation of the project. Their expertise in the area of interventions is undisputed and this project will support to ensure continuity in provision of comprehensive eye care services to people of Eastern Equatoria. that CBM has strategically put significant investments. The Partner Assessment provided areas of capacity strengthening that the partner committed to address, and this will be closely monitored and supported by CBM.

• 3418 consultations in 6 months (out of which 923 male, 1025 female, 718 male <18yrs, 752 female <18yrs) in Torit State Hospitals •102 Surgeries (out of which 73 are cataract surgeries with good surgical outcome plus 29 other surgeries inclusive TT and other minor surgeries) •36 patients with 4 children referred for tertiary care •1 Hospital supported with provision of supplies for secondary eye care treatment.

description.narrative: The integration of climate risks in programming includes an undertaking of concrete actions to reduce and/or mitigate risks related to climate change impact and disaster risks ( for example droughts, erosion, salinization, flooding, etc.) The projects we refer to could be on the themes of health education, justice, security, disaster management, finance and livelihoods.
